verdict.pick: Amazon Basics 13‑Gallon Rectangle Soft‑Close Trash Can
verdict.line: Ideal for families who want reliable odor control without spending a lot. It locks in smells, has a soft‑close lid and a large 13‑gallon capacity, making daily trash handling easy. The catch is the lid can be a bit stiff for some users.
